text:
Alex Nguyen: starting my shift. handing off the ongoing alerts — KV eviction noise in eu-west and p99 increase on embeddings queue in us-east. primary: Alex (eu/us overlap). secondary: Jamie (eu support), Priya (us-east).

Jamie Ortiz: noted. are we still on the warmfix for the eviction threshold?

Alex Nguyen: yes. mitigation in progress — we bumped eviction threshold + enabled targeted prefetch for top-ten tenants in eu-west. metrics look better but tail still flaring for some small customers.

incident-bot: ALERT: KV_EVICTION_RATE_HIGH detected on cluster eu-west-2a (threshold breach x3). Pagerduty incident #INC-8742 created.

Lisa Patel: quick checklist for whoever picks up:
- confirm warmfix rollout (k8s rollout status)
- monitor kv evictions, restart any primaries that show >10% eviction rate after 5m
- if regress, failover to secondary pool and engage rel-eng.

Priya Rao: for embeddings queue in us-east, current workaround is rate-shedding at 5% for low-priority customers and enabling soft-prefetch. We've put a temporary quota on bulk-embed jobs.

Alex Nguyen: summary of actions so far:
- eu-west: rolled rc v2.3-kv-warmfix to nodepool-kv-eu (done, 10/10 ready)
- patched runtime to reduce cache churn (hotfix commit: 8f3a2e7)
- enabled per-tenant prefetch on top customers (manual script run)
- us-east: enabled rate-shedding queue policy, re-routed bulk embedding traffic to dedicated sparing pool

Jamie Ortiz: good. handing off observability: Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/kv-evict?orgId=1
alert runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction (see mitigation steps, postmortem checklist)

Sam Kline: quick note — customers impacted list is small but noisy: cust-a (support ticket open), cust-d reporting timeouts. Support has ticket numbers #SUP-4421, #SUP-4428. Keep comms updated.

Alex Nguyen: communication plan:
- Jamie, can you post a customer-facing status on status.redwood.ai saying 'degraded performance for small subset of customers in eu-west and delayed embeddings in us-east' and link to support articles?
- Priya, keep the embeddings routing adjustments for the next 2 hours, then re-evaluate.

Jamie Ortiz: will post. draft: "We're investigating increased KV eviction events impacting a small percentage of requests in EU-West; mitigations are underway. No data loss detected. ETA for next update: 30m." ping @support-leads for customer comms.

Priya Rao: embeddings note — current p99 latency for embed pipeline is 1.8s (baseline 0.9s). Rate-shed at 5% reduced queue depth by ~40%. If we still see p99>2s after 30m, we'll promote the spare pool to primary and do a rolling swap.

Lisa Patel: playbook pointer (copy of snippet):
```
# command to check rollout status
kubectl -n infra rollout status deploy/kv-nodepool-eu
# quick check for eviction rate
curl -s "http://metrics.internal/api/query?m=kv_eviction_rate%7Bregion%3D%5C"eu-west%5C"%7D" | jq .
```

Alex Nguyen: coverage gaps: nightingales overlap finishes at 02:00 UTC, I'm handing off to Jamie who'll be primary till 06:00 UTC, Priya on standby for any routing shifts. If both are offline, Sam will take emergency page.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty reminder — Alex Nguyen is on-call until 23:59 UTC; escalation policy: eng-sre -> eng-platform -> oncall-manager.

Jamie Ortiz: acknowledged. my action items: post status, monitor eu dashboards, verify rollback plan is ready (steps in runbook). I will also check the RC for memory churn vs eviction correlation.

Alex Nguyen: rollback plan (for the record):
1) disable targeted prefetch (script rollback)
2) rollback kv runtime to previous docker tag (8f3a2e7 -> 6b9c4d1) with controlled canary 10% -> 30% -> 100%
3) failover nodepool to secondary if rollback doesn't reduce evictions within 10m of full rollout

Priya Rao: adding test commands for embeddings swap: 
```
# swap routing to spare pool
./deploy_tools route --from embeddings-primary --to embeddings-spare --dry-run=false
# quick validation: send 100 sample embed requests and check 95th perc latency
python tests/send_embed_load.py --count 100 --model small-embed
```

Sam Kline: small customer comms: I'll coordinate with support to draft an update if ticket volume crosses 5 in 30m. current: 2 new tickets in last 10m.

Jamie Ortiz: okay team — i'll watch dashboards and escalate to eng-platform if evictions spike back to >3x baseline. Logging in now.

Alex Nguyen: thanks. leaving a quick TODO for incoming oncall:
- verify incident-bot is still suppressing duplicate alerts (we've seen noisy repeats)
- keep runbook checklist in mind for any topology changes
- if pages escalate, call oncall-manager before broad customer notification to avoid conflicting messages

Priya Rao: thumbs up. I'll be reachable via DM for routing changes.

Alex Nguyen: handing off. good luck. :thumbsup:
